feeds.title: The Library of Congress Blog » African American History
feeds.description: This section of our blog features articles that have to do exclusively with the African American History. Folklife Today is a blog for people interested in folklore, folklife, and oral history.

feeds.title: HistoryExtra » Black History
feeds.description: Explore this exclusive collection of articles and resources examining Black history throughout the world, from Africans in Tudor England to modern civil rights movements.

feeds.title: Black History Research Collective Blog
feeds.description: Black History is everywhere, read our blog to know about Black History and updates about our website. Black History Research Collective is a registered non-profit organization operating in the state of Iowa. Our mission is to identify Black Churches that might be candidates for historic recognition, and facilitate paid student research opportunities.

feeds.title: Black Mail 4U
feeds.description: The Black Mail Blog was launched in July 2015 and features: black history facts, quotes, trivia, news, and info! The purpose of the Black Mail Blog is to share my love and interest in Black History with others. Check out the website to learn about Black History.

feeds.title: Global Black History
feeds.description: Global Black History is a digital repository of authentic African history and thought leadership written by Africans and for Africans. This platform highlights the best in Africa and the African diaspora's innovation and provides collaboration opportunities.

feeds.title: Rediscovering Black History Blog
feeds.description: The blog of the Black history guide, sharing records relating to the Black Experience at the National Archives.

feeds.title: American Heritage Magazine » African-American History
feeds.description: For over 60 years, American Heritage has connected our nation's citizens through exceptional writing by trusted historians. These stories celebrate our country's values, culture and ingenuity.

feeds.title: Black Past » Global African History
feeds.description: The following are short descriptions of individuals, places and events which have contributed to the shaping of African American history. These encyclopedia entries serve as a starting point for much more inclusive descriptions and discussions that appear in other sources. BlackPast is dedicated to providing a global audience with reliable and accurate information on the history of African America and of people of African ancestry around the world.

feeds.title: Historic Environment Scotland Blog » Black History
feeds.description: Visit our blog to find out the latest news from the historic environment and learn about Black History. Historic Environment Scotland is the lead public body set up to investigate, care for and promote Scotland's historic environment.

feeds.title: Yocum African American History Association Blog
feeds.description: The Yocum African American History Association (YAAHA) is a 501 (c) (3) organization dedicated to sharing educational resources about black American history.

feeds.title: The Lee County Black History Society Blog
feeds.description: The Lee County Black History Society Blog share articles and posts of Black History that everyone should know about. The Lee County Black History Society, Inc. evolved from Attorney and Educator, Janice Cass's desire to commemorate Black History Month on a countywide basis. Our mission is to Preserve and commemorate the cultural and educational contributions by both locally and nationally known Black People.
